# Qt add-on modules for every install-qt-action step, by install profile. Read through
# scripts/qt_modules.sh; scripts/check_qt_module_lists.py refuses a hand-written `modules:`.
#
# Profiles: app (every native app build), desktop (Linux/Windows/macOS on top of app),
# macos (macOS on top of desktop), wasm-host (host tools for the Wasm build), wasm (Wasm target).
#
# qttasktree is unused by Decenza. Qt6Qml includes every installed QML plugin config
# (qtbase/cmake/QtPublicPluginHelpers.cmake:596-640), and Qt.labs.assetdownloader, built from
# qtdoc into the native installs, links Qt6::TaskTree (qtdoc/src/assetdownloader/CMakeLists.txt:20).
# Without it every native configure warns "...dependency Qt6TaskTree could not be found".
#
# The `profiles` line declares every valid profile; a row naming any other is an error.
profiles            app desktop macos wasm-host wasm
#
# module            profiles
qtquick3d           app wasm-host wasm
qtshadertools       app wasm-host wasm
qtgraphs            app wasm-host wasm
qtconnectivity      app
qtmultimedia        app
qtpositioning       app
qtspeech            app
qtwebsockets        app wasm
qtremoteobjects     app wasm-host
qtwebview           app
qtimageformats      app wasm
qtcanvaspainter     app wasm-host wasm
qttasktree          app
qtserialport        desktop
qtwebengine         macos
